description: Search Supertoinette by a dish or an ingredient. Each row carries the identifier to read the recipe with get_recipe. The site publishes no total, so 'total_available' is null and 'last_page' says how far the results run. The categories it counts beside a search are returned as 'facets': pass one back as 'category' to narrow the search, spelled exactly as the site spells it. A category the site does not know is answered like a search that matched nothing, so a filter that finds nothing is dropped and the answer says so.

category.description: Narrow the search to one category, taken from the 'facets' of a previous answer and spelled exactly as the site spells it. Never build one by hand: the site answers a wording it does not know with a page that reads as an absence.

limit.description: Rows to render, 20 by default. The site serves at most 39 to a page, and 'rows_published' always states what the page held.

page.description: Which page of results to read, 1 by default. 'last_page' says how far they run.

query.description: A dish or an ingredient to look for, in French.

name: search_recipes

category.description: The category the answer was narrowed to, or null for a search across all of them.

facets.description: The categories the site counts inside this search. A recipe filed under two is counted by both, so these do not add up to the rows served.

last_page.description: The highest page the site links to from this one.

page.description: The page these rows were read from.

categories.description: The categories the site files the row under.

title.description: The title with the pictogram the site opens it with taken off.

url.description: The public page. Show this when citing the recipe.

rows_published.description: Rows the page held, before any were rendered.

total_available.description: Supertoinette prints no total on a search page, so there is none to report.

url.description: The page these rows were read from.

title: Search the recipes
